jobs.description:
Vontobel hat eine starke Marktposition in der Vermögensverwaltung für Pensionskassen und hat auch das Geschäft für individualisierte Vorsorgelösungen (1e, Kadervorsorge, Freizügigkeit und Säule 3a) in den letzten Jahren erfolgreich entwickelt. Zum weiteren Wachstum unseres Vorsorgegeschäfts suchen wir eine/n abschlussstarke/n und fachlich hervorragend qualifizierte/n Spezialisten/in zur Stärkung unseres Teams in Zürich.

Was sind Deine Aufgaben

• Ansprache und Akquisition von Kunden im Zielsegment der Vorsorgelösungen, n amentlich Führungskräfte, Selbstständigerwerbende und Unternehmer, durch den Vertrieb der 1e-Kadervorsorge-Lösungen der Bank

• Akquisition von Neukunden im Bereich der übrigen Kadervorsorge, der Freizügigkeit und der Säule 3a

• Cross-Selling in verschiedene weitere Bereiche der Bank, insbesondere ins Wealth Management

• Systematische Bearbeitung des Brokermarktes und Aufbau eines Netzes von Vermittlern, Beratern und Intermediären in Ihrer Region

• Beratung von anspruchsvollen Kunden im Bereich sämtlicher Vorsorgelösungen

Was erwarten wir?

• Hervorragende Akquisitions-, Beratungs- und Verhandlungskompetenz

• Starkes Netzwerk von externen Business Partnern

• Fundierte Beratungskompetenz in sämtlichen Themen der Finanz- und Vorsorgeberatung inkl. Pensionskassenthemen, Vorsorgeplanung, Finanzplanung, Steuern, etc.

• Langjährige Erfahrung im Bereich der beruflichen Vorsorge, z.B. bei einem Versicherer oder bei einer Bank

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Vermögensverwaltung und/oder der Anlageberatung

• Akademische Ausbildung mit Abschluss und/oder hochstehende Ausbildungen im Bereich der Finanzplanung oder der beruflichen Vorsorge

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Unternehmerische, motivierte, teamfähige und gewinnende Persönlichkeit mit souveränem Auftritt, Empathie und der Fähigkeit, die Sprache des Kunden zu sprechen

• Bereitschaft zur kundenbezogenen Reisetätigkeit in der gesamten Deutschschweiz, vor allem im Grossraum Zürich

Was wir bieten:

• Ein hochinteressantes Arbeitsumfeld mit komplexen Fragestellungen, moderner Technologie und einem starken Innovationsfokus.

• Ein dynamisches und internationales Umfeld mit vielen Ideen, das Flexibilität und die kontinuierliche Kalibrierung der Prioritäten erfordert, ohne das langfristige Ziel aus den Augen zu verlieren.

• Die Möglichkeit, Ende-zu-Ende-Perspektiven auf das Client Management zu gewinnen und Prozesse über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg zu gestalten.

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und zahlreiche Chancen, Neues zu lernen und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Wir suchen nach talentierten Menschen und nicht nur nach einem Lebenslauf, der alle Kriterien erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht alles mitbringst, was wir von dir verlangen, solltest du dich bewerben.

Bei Vontobel arbeitest du an einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und dich selbst. Bis 2030 wollen wir als eines der führendsten und vertrauenswürdigsten globalen Investmenthäuser bekannt sein. Wir beschäftigen mehr als 2.300 Mitarbeitende an über 25 Standorten weltweit und haben unseren Hauptsitz in Zürich.
Wir befinden uns mehrheitlich in Familienbesitz und sind börsenkotiert. Unsere Fähigkeit, uns langfristig auf Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit zu konzentrieren, wird durch die Sicherheit des 100-jährigen Engagements der Familie untermauert. Wir suchen diverse Talente, die in einer sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen und die aus den unterschiedlichsten Bereichen kommen.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environme

jobs.title: Senior Relationship Manager EAM UK (100%)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the financial world and do you enjoy building and maintaining long-lasting relationships with clients? Our EAM desk covering the United Kingdom is looking for a Relationship Manager to join their team.

What would your role be?

• Development of the United Kingdom as B2B market for Bank Vontobel

• Take over an existing client portfolio

• Develop new client connections, bring in existing own client relationships, and be responsible for acquiring new business from with a focus on the United Kingdom

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients and prospects by providing recommendations that encompass multiple products and services

• Develop in-depth understanding of client’s needs, preferences and overall wealth and be responsive to the changes in the business environment or clients’ needs

• Effectively manage your book of clients and act as a relationship lead accountable for the clients’ experience

• Leverage specialists, service officers and other expert resources to ensure the integrated delivery of investment fiduciary, credit, and banking solutions

What are we looking for?

• An Education in the field of finance or economics

• At least five years of experience as a Relationship Manager (experience supporting external asset managers (EAM) is an asset)

• A good network of potential of multifamily offices and financial intermediaries in the United Kingdom

• A client-focused individual with exceptional interpersonal skills, high motivation and entrepreneurial spirit

• Solution-oriented and considerable sales and financial aptitude

• Pro-active, analytical, and structured

• Fluent in German, English

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

jobs.title: Expert IT Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about IT security and ready to take on exciting challenges in a dynamic environment? We are seeking a skilled and versatile Senior IT Security Engineer to join our Security Engineering team in Zurich. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring our platforms meet the highest security standards while driving the successful implementation of innovative IT security projects.

What would your role be?

• Design, plan, procure, install, and configure new IT security solutions, as well as optimize the existing IT security infrastructure.

• Act as an IAM expert by securing our access infrastructure, optimizing authentication flows, and ensuring seamless integration of various business applications.

• Lead IT security infrastructure projects.

• Take application ownership for IT security platforms, including operations, monitoring, 3rd-level support, and on-call duty.

• Further develop IT security architecture and create corresponding concepts and standards.

• Advise and support system and application owners, as well as internal or external project managers, on IT security topics.

What are we looking for?

• Extensive technical expertise in the Ping Identity platform (formerly ForgeRock) is essential.

• Degree from a higher education institution (e.g. university, technical university, or university of applied sciences) in computer science or an equivalent qualification with a focus on IT.

• Additional training or certifications in IT security (e.g. CAS IS/MAS IS, CISSP, CISA).

• Demonstrated experience as a software developer specializing in IT security.

• Broad IT security expertise and hands-on experience in implementing multiple projects.

• Strong general IT application and infrastructure knowledge, as well as project management experience, preferably in the financial sector.

• Excellent conceptual, analytical, and communication skills.

• Fluency in both German and English.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

jobs.title: Senior AI Architect (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At Vontobel, AI is moving beyond pilots.
We are building production-grade, regulated, and scalable AI systems — and we are looking for the architecture leader who sets the technical direction behind them.
As Senior AI Architect, you own the AI architecture across the firm: from LLM- and agent-based solutions to the enterprise platforms, guardrails, and standards that make them work in production.

What would your role be?

• Define, own, and continuously evolve the enterprise AI architecture and lead hands-on delivery of production-grade AI solutions end-to-end.

• Design and build LLM- and agent-based AI systems

• Establish and apply hands-on best practices for LLM and RAG architectures

• Architect scalable, secure, and resilient AI platforms, leveraging distributed and event-driven architectures

• Act as a hands-on architecture leader, mentoring senior engineers, leading architecture and design reviews, and delivering production-ready prototypes and reference implementations.

• Work closely with Product, Security, Risk, Legal/Compliance, and IT, ensuring AI solutions meet regulatory, governance, and model-risk requirements, while leading the AI Developer Guild to raise engineering standards and capability across the organization.

What are we looking for?

• A hands-on senior AI architecture leader, not a purely strategic person with deep engineering experience (8+ years in software engineering), including several years in architecture or technical leadership roles delivering production-grade AI / LLM solutions.

• Strong backend and systems engineering expertise, with deep hands-on experience in Python and modern API/service development

• Practical experience engineering LLM-powered applications, including LLMs, RAG, and agent-based patterns

• Solid MLOps and AI platform engineering background, covering model and prompt lifecycle management, offline and online evaluation, drift detection, reproducibility, and auditability of AI systems.

• Proven DevOps and cloud architecture experience, including CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, container platforms (Kubernetes/OpenShift), observability, and secure cloud-native architectures (preferably Azure).

• Comfort working in regulated, enterprise environments, balancing speed, quality, and risk while collaborating closely with Security, Risk, Compliance, and IT stakeholders.

• A pragmatic, communicative leader and mentor, comfortable owning decisions, navigating ambiguity, influencing multiple teams, and continuously raising the technical bar; fluent in English, with German as a strong plus.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship,

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy the idea of playing a pivotal role in the success of a key function of a global investment house?

In this role, we are looking for an organized and reliable Executive Assistant who will support the Head Investments and will have direct exposure to international business situations and to a wide range of counterparts.

Please note this is a 100% role due to workload required.

What would your role be?

• Independently and professionally manage the secretariat of the Head Investments and support him in his day-to-day business by thinking independently and with foresight.

• Manage the demanding agenda with overview and care, taking minutes during meetings but also planning and coordinating internal and external meetings, townhalls, offsite workshops, and other special events and ensuring structured and timely follow-ups.

• Support selected Business Management tasks beyond the classic Executive Assistant role (e.g. creating strategic management documents and presentations, consolidation of financial data from various stakeholders etc.)

• Manage other general administrative tasks (e.g. checking and allocating invoices, accepting expenses) efficiently and critically and plan and coordinate business trips, including booking of hotels, flights, restaurants and meetings.

• Handle internal and external correspondence in German and English on a high professional level.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, always ensuring professional representation of the Head Investments.

What are we looking for?

• Similar experience, preferably within an international company in the financial industry (Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Banking, Insurance).

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience as an executive assistant

• Excellent organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage a demanding agenda

• High level of discretion, reliability and a service-oriented mindset

• Ability to provide support for Business Management tasks

• Commercial training or similar, ideally supplemented by further training as an executive assistant and/or assistant; a bachelor’s degree is a plus.

• Excellent MS Office skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) and familiarity with modern communication tools.

• Excellent written and spoken German and English skills and the ability to communicate with stakeholders on all seniority levels are a must.

• Experience working in a fast-paced environment.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship,

jobs.title: Senior Cross-Border Project Specialist (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen eine engagierte, analytische und gestaltungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft des Cross-Border-Managements aktiv weiterentwickelt. Wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, komplexe Fragestellungen strukturierst und in einem internationalen Umfeld echten Impact erzielen möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Was sind Deine Aufgaben:

• Sicherstellung sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines ganzheitlichen, und wirkungsvollen Cross-Border Frameworks (inkl. Methoden, Prozesse und Reporting, unter gezielten Einsatz von Automatisierung und KI-Technologien

• Verantwortung für die Planung, Koordination und Implementierung von anspruchsvollen Cross-Border-Projekten mit hoher Sichtbarkeit

• Zentrale Fachstelle für Cross-Border Fragestellungen: Beratung, Koordination und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Relationship Manager, Sparring Partner für Market Heads und Senior Management

• Analyse, Erarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von Cross-Border relevanten Richtlinien, Entscheidungsgrundlagen und Reports unter Einbezug von KI-gestützter Analyse- und Reportingtools

• Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Cross-Border-Governance, Prozess- und Operating-Modellen

• Mitarbeit und inhaltliche Unterstützung bei internen Audits sowie regulatorischen Prüfungen

Was erwarten wir?

• Abgeschlossenes Hoch- oder Fachhochschulstudium (Wirtschaft, Recht, Finance oder vergleichbar)

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Cross-Border in der Finanzbranche, zwingend in der «First Line of Defense» im Private Clients Umfeld, Beratungserfahrung ist ein Plus

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Projekt- und Stakeholdermanagement kombiniert mit ausgezeichneter Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse der (Front-)Kernprozesse einer Bank sowie relevanter regulatorischer nationaler und internationaler Themen (z. B. CRD VI, MiFID II, FIDLEG, GWG)

• Spezifische Fachkenntnisse in operationellen Risiken, Key Risk Indikatoren, Risk- & Control Self-Assessment sowie Testing und Dokumentation von Kontrollen

• Proaktive, belastbare, selbstbewusste Persönlichkeit mit analytischer, pragmatischer und ergebnisorientierter Denkweise sowie ausgeprägter Change- und Development-Mentalität

Was wir bieten:

• Ein fachlich anspruchsvolles und zukunftorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit komplexen Fragestellungen, moderner Technologie und starken Innovationsfokus

• Ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, das Flexibilität erfordert und gleichzeitig klare langfristige Ziele verfolgt

• Die Möglichkeit, End-to-End-Perspektiven auf das Client Management zu gewinnen und Prozesse sowie Governance aktiv mitzugestalten

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Sichtbarkeit und zahlreiche Chancen zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung,

Wir suchen nach talentierten Menschen und nicht nur nach einem Lebenslauf, der alle Kriterien erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht alles mitbringst, was wir von dir verlangen, solltest du dich bewerben.

Bei Vontobel arbeitest du an einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und dich selbst. Wir beschäftigen mehr als 2.300 Mitarbeitende an über 25 Standorten weltweit und haben unseren Hauptsitz in Zürich.
Wir befinden uns mehrheitlich in Familienbesitz und sind börsenkotiert. Unsere Fähigkeit, uns langfristig auf Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit zu konzentrieren, wird durch die Sicherheit des 100-jährigen Engagements der Familie untermauert. Wir suchen diverse Talente, die in einer sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen und die aus den unterschiedlichsten Bereichen kommen.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the man

jobs.title: Investment Risk Manager
jobs.description:
At Vontobel, we are committed to actively shaping our future. We strive to engage and promote talent of varying age and gender, with a diverse range of experience, from various backgrounds.

We create and pursue investment opportunities that get our clients ahead. As a global investment manager, we believe in high conviction asset management and investment solutions. With portfolio management teams in New York, London and Zurich, Vontobel Asset Management is a specialized investment manager with a multi-boutique approach and a track record of strong and consistent growth. We focus on Equities, Fixed Income, Multi Asset Class, and Alternative Investing, actively managing over CHF 100bn of assets on behalf of institutional and intermediary clients globally.

Our Investment Risk Team measures, assesses and challenges all investment-related risks (e.g. market, credit and counterparty, liquidity, ESG) in our actively managed investment portfolios and monitors implementation of mitigation measures. The team also plays an active role to support and shape the Risk Infrastructure landscape.

In this important role you will focus on independent risk analysis, assessment and when needed escalation relating to actively managed investment products across all boutiques. The function’s stakeholders are the firm’s senior management and investment teams.

The role will be based in Zurich.

What would your role be?

• Identify, assess, measure, monitor, mitigate and report on market, liquidity, credit, counterparty and sustainability risks across multiple asset classes and investment structures.

• Provide an independent view of investment risk profiles to investment teams, deploying quantitative tools such factor risk decomposition, scenario simulations and other stress tests.

• Agree appropriate investment risk measures to be monitored and reviewed as appropriate, and escalate issues where required.

• Organise and manage formal risk reviews with investment teams.

• Contribute to interactions with internal and external stakeholders, e.g. clients, auditors, in the capacity of subject matter expert on investment risk management.

• Be a contributor to the different Governance Bodies, such as Investment Performance Committee and other executive committees.

• Collaborate as required with other Risk functions within Vontobel, including Operational Risk, Investment Control, Compliance and Management Company risk teams.

• Support the Head of Investment Risk in developing and maintaining an adequate risk management framework and infrastructure that maximise efficiency whilst ensuring completeness and effectiveness. Also ensuring that best practice risk governance is in place and followed and fostering a positive risk culture across the firm.

What are we looking for?

• Industry experience: at least 5 years’ experience in an investment risk management or portfolio management role, preferably in an asset management firm.

• Quantitative and/or quantitative finance related education: a first degree in a strongly quantitative subject, such as engineering, physics or applied mathematics or an education in economics or finance. A CFA, FRM or other industry qualification would be an advantage.

• Asset class and financial instrument knowledge: a strong base in at least one of fixed-income (rates and credit) and equities asset classes, with a good understanding of FX and multi-asset investing, and an all-round understanding of risks and pricing of derivative instruments.

• Quantitative and programming skills: experience of deploying databases and programming languages to manage, analyse and interpret data. (e.g. SQL, Python, R, Matlab)

• Specific subject knowledge: multi-factor market risk modelling, liquidity risk modelling and concepts of counterparty risk.

• First-hand experience of risk systems (e.g. MSCI BarraOne, MSCI RiskMetrics, Bloomberg Enterprise)

• Regulatory knowledge: experience of the Swiss and Luxembourg regulatory framework for inve

titleByLocale.en: Senior Web / Software Developer – Atlassian Confluence & Microsoft SharePoint (80-100%)

jobs.description:
Ready to move beyond “keep-the-lights-on” and shape the future of a global bank’s digital workplace?
At Vontobel, we’re transforming our core collaboration platforms from on-prem Atlassian to Confluence Cloud, while evolving SharePoint into a powerful, modern intranet experience used by every employee, every day.
As a Senior Web / Software Developer, you won’t just support systems; you’ll redefine them. Take ownership, drive innovation, and build solutions that truly matter across the organization.
If you’re hands-on, forward-thinking, and excited to make a visible impact, this is your chance to lead from the front.

What would your role be?

• Own and deliver the technical implementation of intranet and collaboration use cases across Microsoft SharePoint and Atlassian Confluence, from requirements to production operations.

• Play a leading engineering role in the migration from on‑prem Atlassian Data Center to Confluence Cloud (Enterprise) and related platform evolution.

• Design, build, and maintain modern SharePoint Online solutions (sites, information architecture, permissions, content models, search, and governance) with a strong focus on developer-grade extensibility.

• Build and evolve intranet features and integrations (e.g., navigation, publishing patterns, content rollups, automation, and platform-wide components) that scale to a firm-wide audience.

• Develop and maintain integrations and migration tooling between Confluence and SharePoint (content move, metadata mapping, link integrity, redirects, and quality checks) to enable a controlled, low-risk transition.

• Act as a senior hands-on engineer: lead code reviews, establish engineering standards, improve CI/CD and operational readiness, and mentor colleagues working on the intranet and platform ecosystem.

What are we looking for?

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related field, or a completed software engineering apprenticeship.

• At least 5 years of hands-on professional experience as senior web / software engineer with strong delivery track record in enterprise platforms and high-visibility web systems such as intranets.

• Deep, current expertise in Microsoft SharePoint (development and administration) including modern SharePoint patterns and operating models in a regulated environment.

• Strong experience building web solutions (TypeScript/JavaScript, modern frontend, APIs) and implementing secure, maintainable backend services where needed.

• Practical know-how with Atlassian ecosystems (Confluence/Jira) and the ability to engineer solutions across both on‑prem and cloud setups.

• Solid understanding of identity, permissions, and governance concepts, comfortable designing and operating access models for bank-wide information platforms.

• Experience with migrations (platform or content), including planning, tooling, validation, stakeholder communication, and incremental rollout strategies.

• A pragmatic, communicative team player who can own decisions, handle ambiguity, and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, security, and IT operations.

• Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

• Lots of special perks, including home office possibility up to 20%

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’r

titleByLocale.it: Client Portfolio Manager for Discretionary Mandates
titleByLocale.en: Client Portfolio Manager for Discretionary Mandates
titleByLocale.de: Client Portfolio Manager for Discretionary Mandates
titleByLocale.fr: Client Portfolio Manager for Discretionary Mandates

jobs.description:
We are looking for an initiative, independent and persuasive personality who is willing to take on great responsibility & challenging tasks as Client Portfolio Manager for Discretionary Mandates.

What would your role be?

• Act as first entry point to and expert for Vontobel’s discretionary (DPM) offering within Private Clients

• Be a sparring partner for relationship managers with respect to multi asset managed solutions, supporting them to propose standard or custom mandates

• Interact with relationship managers and clients as specialist for macro views, portfolio positioning, performance development and portfolio management

• Prepare investment proposals and pitches for Private Clients and run client meetings together with relationship managers also for the French speaking part of Switzerland

• Join internal and client events as specialist for discretionary mandates

• Preparation of monthly performance updates for our Portfolio Managers

• Responsible for dedicate d special mandates (product ownership). Close collaboration with respective portfolio manager

• Be part of a dynamic, diverse team representing a strategically important business of Vontobel

What are we looking for?

• University degree in finance and at least 5 years of experience in the financial industry, with focus on advising internal or external clients on investment solutions

• Ability to adjust according to audience as we communicate to clients across different regions and channels, across format that range from one to one meeting to key note speeches

• Conviction to achieve our goals with our business partners

• Willingness to work within an organization with a high sales and outgoing approach

• Highly motivated team player, with strong analytical skills and willingness to take ownership on several tasks. Knowledge of one or more programming languages would be a valuable asset to the role.

• Flexible, proactive, open-minded attitude, with a strong desire to improve things

• Excellent knowledge and experience in financial markets and instruments, portfolio management and investments

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in French, German, English and strong client presentation and communication skills. French, English and German speaking is a must!

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in over 25 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus on topics such as sustainability is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital s

jobs.title: Head Mortgage Lending - Credit Structuring and Approval

titleByLocale.it: Head Mortgage Lending - Credit Structuring and Approval
titleByLocale.en: Head Mortgage Lending - Credit Structuring and Approval
titleByLocale.de: Head Mortgage Lending - Credit Structuring and Approval
titleByLocale.fr: Head Mortgage Lending - Credit Structuring and Approval

jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead high-stakes mortgage decisions while shaping the strategy of a credit portfolio? Within our Risk department, we are looking for someone to lead our Mortgage Lending – Credit Structuring and Approval team.

What would your role be?

• Manage and lead the mortgage credit structuring and approval team, including hiring, development, coaching, and performance management of team members whilst promoting team spirit, collaboration, and a high-performance culture

• Foster a strong, shared risk culture within the team, promoting accountability, sound judgment, and adherence to the bank’s risk appetite and standards

• Actively manage the existing credit book and ensure appropriate oversight for all relevant processes and responsibilities within the mortgage lending process

• Drive and take full responsibility for the analysis, structuring and underwriting of larger and more complex mortgage requests

• Constructively challenge, offer solutions, and provide risk-oriented advice in structuring credit solutions and pro-actively work with stakeholders in the front organization to ensure implementable outcomes in line with the bank’s credit risk appetite and policies are met

• Proven capability to navigate complex discussions and confidently challenge viewpoints where appropriate

• Collaborate closely and communicate effectively with our front office, second line of defence, legal & compliance and senior management

• Actively support and take ownership for the implementation of the mortgage strategy incl. related projects and initiatives as special matter expert

• Constantly drive development and improvement of our credit processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness

What are we looking for?

• University degree in Banking & Finance or equivalent higher education

• At least 15+ years of proven experience and expertise in a Swiss mortgage credit underwriting function in the financial industry

• Excellent understanding and in-depth knowhow of the Swiss mortgage business with international clientele, related end-to-end processes and the Swiss real estate market

• Strong analytical and structuring skills, combined with a “can-do” attitude, an ability to judge risks independently and enable business thanks to also a strong client and service-focus

• Strong negotiation and communication skills in German and English (additional French and/or Italian would be an asset), combined with the ability to develop and maintain a professional stakeholder management

• Experience in the management of a small team as well as a Swiss mortgage book

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Do you want to be Vontobel ?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment

jobs.title: Head of Fixed Income Sales
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take on a leadership role and shape the future of a high-performing Fixed Income Sales and Capital Markets franchise?

We are looking for a new Head of Fixed Income Sales to succeed the current leadership and further develop our established institutional client and capital markets business.

As Head of Fixed Income Sales, you will lead the franchise, combining active client engagement with strategic leadership and commercial accountability.

What would your role be?

• Lead and manage the Fixed Income Sales team (5 FTEs), fostering a high-performance culture, mentoring talent, and ensuring strong collaboration across functions.

• Own the P&L of the Fixed Income business, including revenue generation, cost management, and budget planning/monitoring.

• Define and execute the strategic direction of the Fixed Income Sales franchise, ensuring sustainable growth and market relevance.

• Provide comprehensive sales coverage of the Fixed Income product range (government bonds, SSAs, covered bonds, corporate bonds, private placements, etc.).

• Maintain and further develop senior client relationships with key Swiss and international institutional investors, acting as a trusted partner.

• Take full responsibility for Lead Manager and syndicate roles in primary market transactions, driving execution and coordination across internal and external stakeholders.

• Ensure the delivery of high-quality market intelligence, investment ideas, and product updates to clients.

• Act as a key interface with internal stakeholders (trading, research, structuring, treasury, risk, compliance), ensuring seamless execution and best-in-class client service.

• Monitor mar ket trends, regulatory developments, and competitor activity to position the franchise competitively.

What are we looking for?

• Advanced education in banking / finance; university degree or CFA / FRM is a strong plus.

• Extensive experience (typically 8–12+ years) in Fixed Income Sales, with a strong focus on CHF markets.

• Proven leadership experience, including managing teams and driving performance in a front-office environment.

• Demonstrated track record in revenue generation and client franchise development, with P&L responsibility preferred.

• Established and transferable client network among Swiss and international institutional investors.

• Deep understanding of fixed income products, primary and secondary markets, and regulatory frameworks.

• Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to translate market opportunities into revenue.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with executive presence.

• Fluency in German (mandatory) and English; French and/or Italian is a strong asset.

• Entrepreneurial, team-oriented leader with the ability to perform under pressure and drive change.

What do we offer?

• Experienced, diverse team in an international environment.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to delive

jobs.title: Lead Data Platform Architect - Institutional Clients Platform

titleByLocale.it: Lead Data Platform Architetto - Institutional Clients Platform
titleByLocale.en: Lead Data Platform Architect - Institutional Clients Platform
titleByLocale.de: Lead Data Platform Architect - Institutional Clients Platform
titleByLocale.fr: Lead Data Platform Architecte - Institutional Clients Platform

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning complex data into clean, reliable solutions that drive real business value? For our Institutional Clients Platform team within the Technology & Services division, we are looking for a Lead Data Platform Architect who combines deep data engineering expertise with strong software engineering skills - someone who can not only shape and model data, but also write the code to bring it to life.

You'll design and evolve our data architecture, build robust data pipelines, and develop the software solutions that connect data producers and consumers across our platform - all while collaborating closely with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.

What would your role be?

• Define and evolve our data architecture - establish clear patterns, standards, and best practices across the platform.

• Establish and enforce data standards, model design principles, and governance models across the platform.

• Turn complex, disparate data sources into clean, well-documented data models that business teams can rely on.

• Design and implement data contracts between producers and consumers, ensuring reliable, versioned, and well-documented interfaces.

• Own end-to-end pipeline delivery - from source data validation and reconciliation through to consumption-ready models.

• Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and transformation logic using dbt-core and Snowflake.

• Implement data quality frameworks and automated testing to ensure trustworthy data at every layer.

• Work within a web services environment, integrating data flows across APIs and services.

• Contribute to and help shape CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices for data workloads.

• Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders in an agile environment.

• Contribute to platform hygiene - Snowflake access control, cost monitoring, and resource management (~5% of your time).

What are we looking for?
Must have:

• Strong SQL skills (any dialect - you'll be working primarily with Snowflake).

• Strong data modeling / data architecture skills - you can take messy, inconsistent data and shape it into coherent, maintainable models.

• Strong software engineering skills - proficiency in C#/F# and/or Python, with proven experience building production-grade code (APIs, data access layers, automation scripts, pipelines).

• Experience with dbt or similar transformation tools (Dataform, SQLMesh, etc.).

• Snowflake (or any other DB) administration experience (RBAC, warehouses, cost management, data sharing, query profiling, etc.).

• Experience implementing data contracts, data quality frameworks, and source data validation/reconciliation.

• Familiarity with CI/CD tooling and version-controlled data workflows (git, pipelines, testing).

• Experience establishing data standards, governance models, and model design principles in a team setting.

• Exposure to web services / microservices architectures and integrating data across service boundaries.

Strong plus:

• Experience in a team lead or senior/lead role - mentoring engineers or driving technical direction.

• Knowledge of financial instruments (asset management or structured products).

• Exposure to State Street's Alpha Data Platform or similar.

You are:

• Equally comfortable writing dbt models and configuring Snowflake roles.

• Pragmatic, structured, and outcome-focused.

• Hands-on and delivery-driven - you write the code, deliver the pipelines, and see things through to production.

• A good communicator who can bridge technical and business conversations.

• Fluent in English; German is a welcome plus.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campu

jobs.title: First Line Controls Specialist (9 - 12 Monate) 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
Für unser Private Clients Business Risk Management Team in der Abteilung «Risk Management & Governance» suchen wir per sofort einen First Line Controls Specialist. Die Position bietet im Rahmen unseres Kontroll-Frameworks eine spannende Möglichkeit, die bestehenden Wealth Management Erfahrungen in den Risiko Management Gebieten zu KYC/ AML, Fraud Prevention und Investor Protection zu vertiefen.

Ihre Herausforderung:

• Übernahme von Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung von Kontrollen und Nachprüfungen innerhalb des Client Segments Private Clients

• Kommunikation von Kontroll-Resultaten an Vertreter der Front Organisation

• Sicherstellung effektiver und empfängergerechten Reporting-Aktivitäten an das Private Clients Management

• Durchführung von Kontroll Assessments im Rahmen des Risk- and Control Self Assessment Prozesses sowie Unterstützung in Prozess- und Risiko Evaluierungen

• Mitarbeit bei der Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung einer effektiven Kontroll-Governance für Vontobel’s internationale Tätigkeiten im Bereich Private Clients

• Koordination und enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, wie z. B. Private Clients Front, Compliance, Non-Financial Risk und Audit

• Unterstützung der Risk Management & Governance Leitung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Front-Organisation als Fachstelle für die Durchführung von First Line Controls

Ihre Qualifikation:

• Abgeschlossenes Hoch- oder Fachhochschulstudium bzw. gleichwertige bankfachliche Aus- und Weiterbildung

• Berufserfahrung aus dem Bereich Business Risk Management/ Kontrollen in der Bankenbranche, vorzugsweise aus einem Wealth Management Umfeld

• Gute Kenntnisse der (Front-)Kernprozesse einer Bank sowie regulatorischer Themenstellungen wie z. B. VSB, GwG, Cross-Border, MiFID II, FIDLEG etc.

• Spezifische Fachkenntnisse bezüglich operationeller Risiken und dem Durchführen, Testen und der Dokumentation von Kontrollen

• Proaktive, engagierte und flexible Person mit sicherem Auftreten, ausgezeichneten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einem gesunden Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der deutschen und englischen Sprache (in Wort und Schrift)

Was bieten wir?

• Top-Lage in Zürich

• Modernste Technologie für Ihren Erfolg und Ihre Karriere.

• Agiles Arbeitsumfeld, das sich in unserem Denken, unseren Arbeitsweisen und unserem gegenseitigen Vertrauen widerspiegelt.

• Flache Hierarchien und Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen.

• Gemeinsamer Teamgeist.

Bei Vontobel gestalten Sie eine bessere Zukunft – für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und Ihre eigene. Als familiengeführtes, börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Mitarbeitenden an 28 Standorten weltweit und Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit.
Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt unterschiedliche Perspektiven, und wir suchen Menschen, die in einer dynamischen und sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung, wenn Sie sich für die Stelle begeistern.
Möchten Sie Vontobel werden?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

jobs.title: Relationship Manager - Romandie
jobs.description:
Do you want an entrepreneurial role with significant scope to create value? Do you have a genuine passion for client acquisition and desire to work with a strong team to consistently build up new business?

Swiss institutional clients, with roots since 1990, are Vontobel Asset Management’s largest segment at CHF 25bn AUM. To capture further growth and reinforce existing client base, we are seeking a Geneva-based Sales person focused on client servicing and acquisition.

What would your role be?

• Partner with the Region Head to strengthen institutional coverage in Romandie

• Drive a structured sales process, from lead generation to conversion, with disciplined pipeline management

• Manage and deepen existing client relationships

• Originate new business opportunities through proven market access

• Develop strong expertise in our investment offering and market needs

• Lead RFP and tender processes, ensuring optimal client solutions in collaboration with support teams

• Enhance operational responsiveness by continuously improving internal processes

• C ontribute to planning regional roadshows and marketing campaigns

What are we looking for?

• Relationship Manager with a proven track record in institutional client acquisition (at least 4 years of sales experience)

• Strong sales capabilities with farming AND hunting mindset

• University degree in business, economics, finance, or a related field

• Established network within Romandie-based institutional clients

• Highly capable of navigating efficiently thru high pressure situations

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively bringing strong entrepreneurial drive and commercial mindset

• Broad investment product knowledge

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills

• Native French and fluent English (written and spoken)

• High level of personal integrity

What do we offer?

• Experienced, diverse team in an international environment.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering exceptional support and ensuring smooth operations in the financial world? We are looking for a highly motivated Specialist 1st Level Front Support to join our Service Hub team. This role is a key part of our organization, providing first-level support to Relationship Managers, Assistants, and the Front Office, ensuring they can deliver outstanding service to our clients.

Our team takes ownership, embraces challenges, and constantly seeks new ways to learn, develop, and improve. We are looking for a new team member who views every interaction as an opportunity to provide efficient, high-quality support and contribute to an excellent client experience. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and are eager to make a difference, we’d love to hear from you!

What would your role be?
As part of the Front Support team, you will play a crucial role as the first and most important point of contact for our Wealth Management Front Office employees. Your primary responsibility will be to provide assistance with general and operational issues, including system-related challenges, process inquiries, access rights, and more.
As a Specialist in 1st Level Front Support, your responsibilities will include:

• Troubleshooting and resolving first-level support issues promptly and effectively.

• Assisting with tools and technical issues to ensure smooth daily operations.

• Resolving access issues, base data challenges, and workflow-related queries.

• Supporting front-office processes and addressing general banking matters.

• Acting as a key point of contact to ensure operational excellence and enhance the client experience.

What are we looking for?
We are looking for a candidate who brings:

• Relevant experience in IT or a similar support role, ideally within wealth management or financial services.

• Solid knowledge of Wealth Management front-office processes, technical tools, and banking operations.

• Genuine passion for delivering personalized and direct phone support, maintaining a friendly, professional, and calm demeanor in high-pressure situations, while providing efficient and effective assistance to Wealth Management stakeholders.

• A hands-on approach, openness to tackling new topics, a strong helper mentality, curiosity, and a drive to understand and resolve problems sustainably.

• A client-focused mindset, proactive attitude, and attention to detail in identifying and resolving issues.

• Willingness to work onsite full-time to ensure close collaboration with the team and direct support for the Front Office.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with oral and written proficiency in German (C2) and English (C1).

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

• Assisting with tools and technical issues to ensure smooth daily operations.

jobs.title: Exotic Derivatives Trader
jobs.description:
Are you ready to operate at the core of a leading Investment Solution franchise?
We are looking for an experienced Exotic Derivatives Trader to join our Zurich-based team, within a market-leading team.

This role combines trading at its core, with direct exposure to franchise development and business expansion across global markets.

What would your role be?

• Manage and oversee risk across our exotic trading books, actively driving P&L through disciplined positioning

• Execute and manage trading strategies on complex exotic structures, ensuring efficient hedging and risk allocation

• Ensure robust, consistent pricing and marking standards

• Deliver high-quality execution and responsiveness to internal stakeholders and clients

• Play a key role in growing the business, identifying opportunities to expand product offering, flows, and client activity, working with colleagues across all continents

• Actively contribute to the scaling of the franchise, supported by strong internal resources

• Work closely with Sales, Structuring, and Technology to enhance trading capabilities

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a strong trading profile with a clear risk-taking mindset and growth ambition:

• A strong financial background with a degree in Engineering, Finance, or a related field

• Proven experience in exotic derivatives trading within a competitive environment

• Quantitative and risk-focused mindset, with a clear approach to managing books and generating performance

• Precision and strong attention to detail

• Ability to combine trading discipline with commercial awareness, identifying and capturing growth opportunities

• Programming background or Python expertise with experience in a financial environment

• A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with experience contributing to franchise development, platform evolution, or expansion initiatives

• Savvy about all asset classes and market developments and ability to position accordingly

• Experience in AQDQ and/or FX is a plus

This is a front-office role for high-potential profiles who demonstrate the right mindset, technical foundation, and ambition to step into a demanding trading environment. We are looking for talent, drive, and the ability to make an impact—people who want to build and push the business forward.

What do we offer?

• Experienced, diverse team in an international environment.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and

titleByLocale.it: Senior Software Ingegnere for Process Platforms
titleByLocale.en: Senior Software Engineer for Process Platforms
titleByLocale.de: Senior Software Ingenieur for Process Platforms
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Software Ingénieur for Process Platforms

jobs.description:
For our technology team in Zurich, we are looking for a highly motivated and skilled Software Engineer. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, implementing, and maintaining systems and interfaces that drive the digitalization of our internal processes. Our modern technology stack includes Java/Kotlin, Kafka, Spring Boot, and OpenShift (Docker).
We are seeking a proactive and communicative individual who enjoys collaborating with stakeholders, translating business needs into technical solutions, and taking ownership from concept to delivery. You will thrive in a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative environment where continuous learning and improvement are encouraged. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear your story and what motivates you.

What would your role be?

• Develop internal applications and/or configure commercial off-the-shelf solutions (e.g., Atlassian Jira) to meet business needs and enhance operational efficiency.

• Take ownership of new initiatives, including stakeholder alignment, requirements engineering, solution design, and system architecture, ensuring scalable and sustainable outcomes.

• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to gather, clarify, and prioritize requirements, acting as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.

• Participate in code reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices, processes, and standards.

• Create and maintain clear and comprehensive documentation for software features, processes, and workflows to ensure transparency and usability.

• Act as a trusted partner by troubleshooting and resolving application issues, ensuring stable and reliable operations.

What are we looking for?

• A bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related field, or a completed software engineering apprenticeship

• Solid experience with Java/Kotlin and a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in software development, showcasing your ability to tackle complex challenges and deliver impactful results

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and explain technical concepts clearly

• Knowledge of Atlassian tools, particularly in configuring and operating Jira and/or willingness to develop such skills

• A growth mindset: You’re eager to learn, take responsibility, and continuously develop yourself.

jobs.description:
Within our Data & AI Solutions Hub, we design, build and operate the enterprise AI platform for Vontobel on Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure and the Power Platform. We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who delivers production-grade GenAI and agentic solutions, turns them into reusable patterns the wider organisation can build upon, and raises the engineering standard for everyone around them. This is a pro-code role at the centre of how the bank adopts AI responsibly, in a Zurich-based team that values judgement as highly as technical depth.

What would your role be?

• Design, build and operate production-grade agentic and GenAI solutions on Microsoft AI Foundry, taking them from prototype through to governed, observable, and fully supported production services.

• Translate recurring business needs into reusable reference architectures and paved-road patterns, so that each new use case builds on a secure, proven foundation rather than starting from scratch.

• Set the pro-code engineering standard for AI across the team, and mentor colleagues working in both pro-code and low-code environments (Copilot Studio, Power Platform) so that good practice scales beyond any individual.

• Make the secure and compliant path the most straightforward path for business teams, by building enablement and self-service into the platform rather than absorbing demand as manual support.

• Treat governance, data classification, identity, and responsible-AI guardrails as integral to the engineering itself — in a regulated banking environment, sound judgement about what not to build is as valuable as the ability to build it.

What are we looking for?

• Demonstrable experience taking at least one agentic or GenAI system from prototype into production within a sensitive or regulated environment, including responsibility for its operation. We will ask you to walk us through what you built, who relied on it, the hardest constraint you designed around, and what you would approach differently today.

• Strong pro-code engineering foundations, with proven proficiency in Python for AI and agent development, complemented by production software experience in at least one of C#/.NET or TypeScript. You write code regularly and intend to keep doing so.

• Hands-on depth in Microsoft AI Foundry and Azure AI services — retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, evaluation, and agent design patterns.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and the Power Platform (including Copilot Studio) is an advantage.

• A first-principles approach to security, data boundaries, and architectural trade-offs, and the confidence to advise a business team against a given approach when circumstances require it.

• A track record of improving the engineers and standards around you — through mentoring, technical leadership, or setting team-wide practice — not solely through individual delivery.

• The ability to learn quickly in a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We are recruiting for your learning ability and judgement, not for a fixed list of certifications.

• Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage given close collaboration with business stakeholders.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.

• Campus feeling and collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally

jobs.title: Transactional Tax Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you flexible, quick to adapt, and able to integrate into a new team? Do you have a passion for working with numbers and the ability to see both the fine details and the big picture? Are you looking for a position in a dynamic and engaging environment that lets you delve into complex tax and regulatory matters? Are you energized by the opportunity to question the status quo and optimize processes and services?

At Vontobel, we invest in people who shape the client’s experience of tomorrow. In our Reporting Services Team in Zurich, you'll join an experienced team managing numerous regulatory reporting and tax services. As a Regulatory Tax Specialist, you will collaborate closely with your IT and business colleagues to achieve shared goals, take ownership of application components and processes, address operational challenges, and contribute to ongoing projects. Together, we deliver high-quality tax services and support internal and external stakeholders with thorough and insightful service.

What would your role be?

• Withholding & transaction tax processing: monitor, deposit, and report on various withholding and transaction taxes, including Swiss turnover tax, Swiss and foreign withholding taxes, and financial transaction taxes (e.g. Spain/Italy/France transaction tax).

• Regulatory tax reporting: plan, support, and coordinate the annual reporting for AIA/CRS, ensuring accurate and timely compliance.

• Inquiry processing & support: analyze and respond to Transaction Tax and CRS related inquiries from all areas of the bank, as well as from external clients, providing professional insights and solutions.

• Implementation of changes: monitor publications of regulatory updates and implement required technical and procedural changes in close collaboration with IT specialists.

• Department representation & process optimization: act as a knowledgeable and reliable representative of the department in bank-wide projects and process enhancement initiatives related to your regulatory reporting and transaction tax topics.

• Process & service development: Pursue the shared goals of regulatory compliance, client satisfaction, quality improvement, efficiency gains, and ensure smooth operations.

What are we looking for?

• A degree in banking & finance, business administration or similar with several years of relevant professional experience in the banking and finance sector.

• Several years of experience in the subject area of Swiss and international Transaction Taxation is a requirement.

• A proactive and independent approach to work, with strong organizational skills and a willingness to take ownership of your work.

• Good analytical skills, a “can-do” mindset, and the ability to work independently.

• A collaborative team player with effective communication skills.

• Proficiency in both German and English.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquarters in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusias

jobs.title: IT On-site Supporter (100%)
jobs.description:
Are you excited by the opportunity to solve complex challenges, drive meaningful change, and work with a collaborative team that values innovation and continuous improvement?
Join our Technology On-Site team in Zurich, where we are looking for a proactive, customer-focused professional with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for delivering high-quality results.

What would your role be?

• Provide technical support for hardware infrastructure and software applications in end-user environments.

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues while offering guidance to internal clients across national and international locations.

• Manage and resolve tickets as part of Incident and Service Request Management processes.

• Assist in preparing IT equipment according to predefined workplace requirements.

• Support the setup and maintenance of multimedia installations in meeting rooms.

• Actively participate in employee workstation relocations, primarily in Zurich.

• Contribute to hardware lifecycle and inventory management processes.

• Ensure the availability and distribution of end-user IT materials globally, including inventory management.

• Collaborate on IT projects, rollouts, and operational tasks.

• Provide multimedia support for technical event management.

What are we looking for?

• Completed apprenticeship in IT or equivalent qualification.

• Strong experience in IT support, ideally within the financial services industry.

• Expertise in Microsoft Windows client environments and the Microsoft Office suite, with strong proficiency in Windows 11 and M365.

• Knowledge of networking, IP telephony, and printing systems.

• Familiarity with multimedia and conferencing systems used for presentations and virtual meetings.

• Flexibility to work outside regular service hours when needed and willingness to travel for short-term assignments at national and international offices.

• A service-oriented, analytical, and solution-focused approach, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.

• A motivated, trustworthy, and dependable team player who can also work effectively independently.

• Fluent in German and English; conversational French or any other language would be an advantage

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual
