jobs.title: Key Client Developer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy acting as a true sparring partner to Relationship Managers, driving the growth of existing UHNW relationships and co-leading new client acquisition?
Our Key Client franchise is a strategic growth pillar, and we are looking for a highly driven and entrepreneurial Key Client Developer to operate at the center of our most important client relationships. The Key Client Management & Family Office team enables our organization to systematically develop and deepen our most valuable client relationships.
You act as a strategic co-pilot to Relationship Managers and senior stakeholders, driving the development of our most sophisticated UHNW and family office relationships. You combine investment expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational influence to originate, shape, and execute complex client opportunities.
While Relationship Managers retain ownership of the client relationship, you lead in identifying client needs, orchestrating the firm’s full capabilities and designing and delivering high-quality solutions. You ensure seamless execution and deliver a consistent, top-tier client experience across the full lifecycle, including after-sales excellence.

• Own the development and execution of holistic client strategies: identify opportunities and drive sustainable growth in partnership with the Relationship Manager

• Design and deliver high-impact, investment-driven client engagements, acting as a credible partner to challenge and shape solutions across asset classes

• Assemble and lead cross-functional deal teams, including senior management and product specialists

• Own the execution of complex client initiatives, ensuring delivery excellence and alignment with client expectations

• Drive initiatives that enhance the effectiveness and scalability of the Key Client platform

• Strong investment expertise across asset classes; CFA, CAIA, or equivalent preferred (or extensive practical experience)

• Proven experience with UHNW and/or institutional clients in complex, solution-driven environments

• Demonstrated ability to execute sophisticated client opportunities

• Exceptional ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority

• Proven track record in building trust with Relationship Managers and translating this into commercial impact

• Strong experience in driving alignment across the firm and beyond

• Clear commercial mindset with strong communication and presentation skills

• Structured, big picture-thinker with high ownership, drive, and execution focus

• Fluent in English and German (Swiss German a plus)

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Have you been part of an agile team that built or evolved an enterprise-grade DevOps platform? Are you experienced in designing and delivering tailored developer workplace solutions? Do you place equal importance on developer experience and security - and know how to seamlessly integrate “Sec” into DevOps? Are you also confident in leveraging AI to enhance modern software development?

For our DevOps Platform team in Zurich, we are looking for an experienced and versatile professional with a strong technical background and a passion for platform engineering and automation. If you thrive on delivering an exceptional developer experience, balancing the diverse needs of development teams, and implementing robust automation aligned with best practices and standards, we would love to hear from you.

What would your role be?

• Design, build, operate, and continuously improve a scalable, resilient platform and workplaces for our development teams.

• Enable automation through CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and self-service tooling.

• Demonstrate deep expertise in Azure cloud, automation tooling, and programming languages.

• Evaluate and adopt new technologies to enhance platform capabilities and efficiency.

• Drive DevOps security by implementing secure coding standards, SAST/DAST, and software supply chain security, while embedding security best practices across the entire software development lifecycle.

• Support the adoption of cutting-edge AI coding assistants and autonomous agents, shaping how they are used to improve developer experience and engineering workflows.

• Act as a trusted partner to development teams by actively supporting, guiding, and educating engineers, driving best practices, and fostering a strong DevOps culture across the organization.

What are we looking for?

• Familiar with different tools and solutions regarding developer workplaces, CI/CD, code security, AI coding assistance.

• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience.

• Highly motivated, committed, used to taking on responsibility and eager to continuously develop yourself further.

• Agile, flexible and appreciative working in an energetic, dynamic team.

• Excellent communication skills in English; German language proficiency is an advantage.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.

• Campus feeling and collaborative spirit.

jobs.title: Head of Controls and Quality Assurance

titleByLocale.en: Head of Controls and Quality Assurance

jobs.description:
Step into a pivotal leadership role where you shape how Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) operates at its core. As Head of Controls & Quality Assurance FCC, you will drive robust control oversight, strengthen compliance frameworks, and lead transformation initiatives that safeguard the organization.

Acting as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, auditors, and regulators, you’ll sit at the heart of decision-making—ensuring risks are effectively managed while championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

What would your role be?

• Lead and develop the Controls & QA team, setting clear objectives and fostering a strong control culture.

• Oversee the FCC control framework, ensuring controls are effective, tested, and continuously improved.

• Monitor control performance, identify risks/gaps, and drive remediation and resilience enhancements.

• Manage internal/external audits, including planning, findings, and timely closure of actions.

• Act as main contact for regulatory engagements, ensuring alignment with expectations and managing responses.

• Establish MI frameworks with clear KPIs/KRIs and deliver actionable insights to senior management.

• Oversee Quality Assurance to assess control effectiveness and ensure compliance with regulations.

• Lead incident management processes, including escalation, root cause analysis, and preventive actions.

• Drive training initiatives to strengthen risk, compliance, and control awareness across the organization.

• Lead transformation and automation of FCC processes (e.g., AML, sanctions, transaction monitoring).

What are we looking for?

• Proven leadership experience within Financial Crime Compliance, Controls, QA, or Risk Management.

• Strong expertise in FCC frameworks (e.g., AML, sanctions, transaction monitoring) and regulatory environments.

• Solid understanding of control design, testing, and continuous improvement practices.

• Experience managing internal/external audits and regulatory interactions.

• Track record of building and leading high-performing teams and fostering a strong risk & control culture.

• Strong analytical mindset with experience in MI reporting, KPIs/KRIs, and data-driven decision-making.

• Experience in transformation, process optimization, and automation initiatives.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels.

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to manage complex risks and incidents.

• Degree in Finance, Law, Business, or related field; relevant certifications (e.g., CAMS, ICA) are a plus.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your applic

jobs.description:
Are you flexible, quick to adapt, and able to integrate into a new team? Do you thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy diverse, hands-on activities? Are you an IT enthusiast with a keen interest in the financial sector, eager to work with cutting-edge technologies, advanced IT infrastructures, and innovative methods? At Vontobel, we invest in people who shape the client experience of tomorrow. In our Reporting Services Team in Zurich, you'll join an experienced team managing numerous regulatory reporting services.

As an Avaloq Parametrization Specialist, you will be an integral part of the Reporting Services Team within the Operation Services Department. In this role, you will collaborate closely with your IT and business colleagues to achieve shared goals, take ownership of application components, address operational challenges, and contribute to ongoing projects. You will play a key role in maintaining and expanding our core banking system, Avaloq, while driving innovation and operational excellence.

What would your role be?

• Parametrization in our core banking system, Avaloq, with a primary focus on our transaction and regulation reporting services under Swiss and European legislation.

• Perform additional Avaloq reporting parametrization activities such as derivative reporting requirements.

• Drive developments forward together with the business experts, perform in-depth requirements analyses, implement new regulatory requirements and process innovations.

• Get involved with solution design, as well as programming, parametrization, and testing to ensure the availability of business-critical regulatory services and to support bank-wide platform projects.

• Pursue the shared goals of regulatory compliance, client satisfaction, quality improvement, efficiency gains, and ensure smooth operations.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

What are we looking for?

• Several years of software engineering experience in the banking and finance sector.

• Relevant Avaloq parametrization experience and a willingness to continuously acquire new knowledge in this area.

• Initial experience with regulatory transaction reporting, such as FinfraG, MiFID II, EMIR, and/or trading related knowledge (STEX) would be beneficial.

• Enthusiasm for new technologies, motivation to master technical knowledge in the complex field of regulatory transaction reporting and the ability to take responsibility.

• Very good communication skills in English and German are mandatory.

• Strong teamwork skills and a willingness to take ownership of your work and personal growth.

• Good analytical skills, solution-oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: .NET Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description:
Do you share our passion for state of the art technologies and want to be part of our team? We look forward to a new colleague that contributes fresh ideas and grows with us to improve our solutions, processes & skills.

As a software developer within our product data engineering team, you are responsible to build and operate applications related to lifecycle event processing of structured products and the distribution of reference data to exchanges, data vendors and partners. We endorse the microservice philosophy and are proud to do multiple deployments to production a day in a fully automated way.

Our language of choice is c# (with .NET 10), the event based services listen to RabbitMQ using MassTransit and we ship our applications in containers.

What would your role be?

• Design, implement, test und operate scalable applications to automate the lifecycle of structured products

• Design and maintain interfaces to internal and external partners in Switzerland, Europe and Asia

• Collaborating closely with the development teams and business in an agile environment

• Work in a diverse and international environment

• further optimize & automate the devops process

• take over 2nd level support tasks

What are we looking for?

• Strong software development skills in C# / .NET Core

• Experience with microservice architecture & containers

• Familiar with messaging & REST-APIs

• Self-initiative to continuously improve our software development process & tools

• Experience with Microsoft Azure is a plus

You are

• Very keen on new technologies

• Willing to assume full ownership of your tasks, projects & applications

• A team player that shares their know how

• Get things done attitude

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

jobs.title: Trader Trackers & Strategies
jobs.description:
Are you looking to take the next step in your career? We are looking for a Trader to join our leading and highly-automated Trackers and Strategies global platform, managing a multi-billion franchise and contributing to the development of new leveraged solutions and Quantitative Investment Strategies.

The role combines trading, market-making, risk management and innovation supported by technical development around our tracker products and actively managed certificates.

You will also deal with strategies of structured products and a large advisory force and client base, internal and external.

What are we looking for?

• Be part of Vontobel’s growing symmetric derivatives business.

• Manage delta 1 products such as active and dynamic Tracker Certificates and Actively Managed Certificates throughout their lifecycle.

• Oversee risk management in our market-making books.

• Execute and manage rebalance orders for Actively Managed Certificates.

• Perform market-making for Tracker Certificates and Actively Managed Certificates.

• Contribute to the development of the next-generation tracker and actively managed certificate platform.

• Support the creation of new product lines and innovative solutions.

• Manage product demands from our global distribution units in Singapore, Hong Kong, Dubai, Switzerland

• A strong financial background with a degree in Banking, Finance, or a related field.

• A related technical degree and/or education (e.g., Python/Scala, Data Science, Big Data, or similar) is key.

• Technical experience in a quantitative or financial environment (e.g., programming, system architecture, or similar).

• Ability to work in a highly technical environment, including troubleshooting and performing technical analysis.

• Experience in multi-asset trading, execution, or risk management of structured products.

• Familiarity with Tracker Certificates and/or Actively Managed Certificates is a strong plus.

• This is a senior role. However, a suitable junior-level profile with a willingness to grow and develop in a dynamic role is encouraged to apply.

• An ambitious attitude to further develop the business and improve processes and systems.

• A client-focused mindset.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. You will also deal with strategies of structured products and a large advisory force and client base, internal and external. What are we looking for?
• Be part of Vontobel’s growing symmetric derivatives business.
• Manage delta 1 products such as active and dynamic Tracker Certificates and Actively Managed Certificates throughout their lifecycle.
• Oversee risk management in our market-making books.
• Execute and manage rebalance orders for Actively Managed Certificates.
• Perform market-making for Tracker Certificates and Actively Managed Certificates.
• Contribute to the development of the next-generation tracker and actively managed certificate platform.
• Support the creation of new product lines and innovative solutions.
• Manage product demands from our global distribution units in Singapore, Hong Kong, Dubai, Switzerland
• A strong financial background with a degree in Banking, Finance, or a related field.
• A related technical degree and/or education (e.g., Python/Scala, Data Science, Big Data, or similar) is key.
• Technical experience in a quantitative or financial environment (e.g., programming, system architecture, or similar).
• Ability to work in a highly technical environment, including troubleshooting and performing technical analysis.
• Experience in multi-asset trading, execution, or risk management of structured products.
• Familiarity with Tracker Certificates and/or Actively Managed Certificates is a strong plus.
• This is a senior role. However, a suitable junior-level profile with a willingness to grow and develop in a dynamic role is encouraged to apply.
• An ambitious attitude to further develop the business and improve processes and systems.
• A client-focused mindset. We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply. At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich. We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel? Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner. At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination. If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

jobs.description:
Interessierst du dich dafür, moderne IT-Lösungen in der Finanzindustrie aktiv mitzugestalten und skalierbare Kundenkommunikation zu entwickeln?

Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und treibe gemeinsam mit uns die Weiterentwicklung unserer Output-Management-Plattform (Customer Communications Management) sowie unserer Archivierungs- und Scanning-Lösungen für die gesamte Vontobel-Gruppe voran.

Wir suchen eine engagierte, praxisorientierte Persönlichkeit mit End-to-End-Verständnis, die Verantwortung übernimmt und sich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT wohlfühlt.

Was wären Ihre Tätigkeiten?

• Verantwortung für Ausbau, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Output-Management-(CCM)-Plattform sowie Mitwirkung an Archivierungs- und Scanning-Lösungen.

• Analyse von Anforderungen zusammen mit den Fachbereichen und Umsetzung in skalierbare technische Lösungen.

• Konzeption, Entwicklung, Konfiguration und Testing inkl. Release- und Deployment-Begleitung (in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern, z. B. Quadient).

• Entwicklung und Betrieb von End-to-End-Lösungen entlang des gesamten Dokumentenprozesses (Rendering, Output Management, Integration).

• Sicherstellung von Stabilität, Performance und Verfügbarkeit der verantworteten Applikationen.

• Zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT mit Fokus auf durchgängiges Prozessverständnis.

• Aktive Mitarbeit an gruppenweiten Transformations- und Plattforminitiativen.

Was suchen wir?

• Ausbildung oder Studium in Informatik sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung im Engineering, Application Management oder Betrieb geschäftskritischer Systeme.

• Erfahrung im Software Engineering, idealerweise im Output Management / CCM Umfeld.

• Gute Kenntnisse in Skriptsprachen (Java) und Datenformaten (XML/JSON) sowie relationalen Datenbanken (SQL).

• Erfahrung in der Integration von Systemen in komplexen IT-Landschaften.

• Kenntnisse in Quadient Inspire Flex Suite, Dokumentenmanagement, Archivierung oder Scanning von Vorteil.

• Verständnis von End-to-End-Dokumentenprozessen und Backend-Integrationen.

• Analytische, lösungsorientierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung.

• Erfahrung in agilen Teams sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Was bieten wir?

• Eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit direktem Impact in zentralen Plattform- und Transformationsprojekten.

• Viel Gestaltungsspielraum sowie flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.

• Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Zürich (Nähe Paradeplatz) sowie flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell.

• Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Offene, kollaborative Teamkultur («One Vontobel»).

• Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen inklusive Bonus und Sozialleistungen sowie kostenloses Mittagessen.

• Zusätzliche Benefits wie Früchte & Kaffee sowie Möglichkeit für zusätzlichen unbezahlten Urlaub.

Wir suchen talentierte Menschen, nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Kriterien erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bei Vontobel bauen Sie an einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft - und für sich selbst. Bis 2030 wollen wir als eine der führenden und vertrauenswürdigsten globalen Investmenthäusern bekannt sein. Wir beschäftigen mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter/Innen an 28 Standorten weltweit und haben unseren Hauptsitz in Zürich.

Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt unterschiedliche Perspektiven, und wir suchen Menschen, die in einer dynamischen und sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung, wenn Sie sich für die Stelle begeistern.
Möchten Sie Vontobel werden?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientatio

jobs.title: Sustainability Manager 80-100%
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about sustainability and looking to join a dynamic and ambitious team?

Sustainability has a long tradition at Vontobel. The Corporate Responsibility team is the competence center for all matters around corporate sustainability. We ensure the continuous development and implementation of Vontobel’s sustainability strategy. Our Corporate Sustainability Committee, composed of senior management representatives from all relevant functions, ensures that sustainability-related considerations are embedded and steered across the firm.

What would your role be?

• Work with Head Corporate Responsibility (CR), the team and relevant internal and external stakeholders to ensure continuous development of the company’s sustainability strategy.

• Support Head CR to prepare the quarterly meetings of Vontobel’s Sustainability Committee and coordinate or implement measures and projects decided.

• Work together with the team members on the annual sustainability disclosures (e.g. Sustainability report, PRI signatory reporting, climate reporting such as TCFD and other sustainability-related surveys).

• Manage the Corporate Sustainability website in close cooperation with internal stakeholders; ensure consistency of content and messaging including the drafting of blog articles and content.

• Monitor regulatory and legislative developments such as NUFG, national CO2 legislations and CSRD ESRS and have the possibility to participate in industry working groups.

What are we looking for?

• Degree in business, economics or environmental or social sciences.

• Knowledge and previous first experience in the areas of corporate sustainability, regulatory disclosures in the financial industry and sustainability report assurance preparation.

• Project work experience in the areas of sustainability (regulatory, environmental or social).

• Familiarity with regulatory issues and the sustainability landscape (national, EU and global).

• Fluency in English and German is required. Writing skills and talent in dealing with languages.

• A team player who is strong in coordination to reach a common and ambitious goal, but also flexible and able to work under pressure.

• Convincing personality, curiosity to learn, and interest in working with a broad range of stakeholders from different fields.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an international environment.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to cr

jobs.title: Business & Project Manager
jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams Business & Project Management in der Abteilung Business & Technology Solutions suchen wir eine belastbare, flexible und zielorientierte Persönlichkeit als Business & Project Manager.

In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für strategische und operative Projekte im Umfeld Transaction Banking und treiben die Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform-, Prozess- und Service-Landschaft aktiv voran.

Was wären Ihre Tätigkeiten?

• Leitung und erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Business-, Transformations- und regulatorischen Initiativen (Scope, Budget, Qualität, Timeline).

• Sicherstellung einer strukturierten Projekt-Governance inkl. Risiko-, Abhängigkeits- und Eskalationsmanagement.

• Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Vorhaben zwischen Business, Operations und IT.

• Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung komplexer Projekte und Initiativen.

• Analyse, Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Prozessen, Betriebsmodellen und Service-Strukturen.

• Sicherstellung regulatorischer Anforderungen in Projekten.

• Aktive Mitgestaltung der Transaction Banking Strategie (Skalierung, Standardisierung, Automatisierung).

• Unterstützung des Managements bei strategischen Fragestellungen und Initiativen.

• Erstellung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen und Management-Reports.

• Stakeholder-Management sowie Koordination interdisziplinärer Teams.

Was suchen wir?

• Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbare Ausbildung.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Business und Projektmanagement im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld.

• Erfahrung in der Leitung und Steuerung komplexer Business- und IT-Projekte.

• Fundiertes Verständnis von Transaction Banking, Banking Operations sowie relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen.

• Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Business- und IT-Projekte inkl. End-to-End-Ownership.

• Sehr gutes Verständnis von Core Banking Systemen (z. B. Avaloq) sowie deren Integration (Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse, Plattformarchitekturen).

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit externen Providern, Vendoren und Plattformlösungen.

• Hohe IT-Affinität sowie ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, auf Senior Management Level adressatengerecht zu kommunizieren und Entscheidungen vorzubereiten.

• Selbständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortng.

• Belastbare, flexible und kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit sicherem Auftreten.

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

• Affinität für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) sowie die Bereitschaft, KI‑gestützte Tools und Arbeitsweisen zu nutzen.

Was bieten wir? (Copied under the your section requirements)

• Eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit direktem Impact in zentralen Plattform- und Transformationsprojekten.

• Viel Gestaltungsspielraum sowie flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.

• Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Zürich (Nähe Paradeplatz) sowie flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell.

• Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Offene, kollaborative Teamkultur («One Vontobel»).

• Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen inklusive Bonus und Sozialleistungen sowie kostenloses Mittagessen.

• Zusätzliche Benefits wie Früchte & Kaffee sowie Möglichkeit für zusätzlichen unbezahlten Urlaub.

Wir suchen talentierte Menschen, nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Kriterien erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel bauen Sie an einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft - und für sich selbst. Bis 2030 wollen wir als eine der führenden und vertrauenswürdigsten globalen Investmenthäusern bekannt sein. Wir beschäftigen mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter/Innen an 28 Standorten weltweit und haben unseren Hauptsitz in Zürich.
Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt unterschiedliche Perspektiven, und wir suchen Menschen, die in einer dynamischen und sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen w
